chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Abdul Azeem ibn Abdullah, who said:
I heard Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) address with this sermon: 'The Praise is for Allah, the Knower of what is to occur before any of His creatures realizes it.'

The Originator of the skies and the earth. The Composer of the causes with what the Pens flow with, and the Ordained matters occur from the precedence of His Knowledge, and a measurement of His Wisdom. I praise Him upon His Bounties, and I seek Refuge with Him from His Vengeance, seeking Guidance of Allah, and I seek Refuge with Him from the straying and the destruction. The one whom Allah Guides, so he has travelled upon the ideal road, and has acquired the best of the booties; and the one whom Allah Lets to stray, so he is perplexed from the guidance and collapsed into the destruction.

And I testify that there is no god except for Allah, One, there being no associates for Him, and that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger, the Chosen one, and His Guardian with whom He is Pleased with, and Sent him with the Guidance. He sent him upon where there was an interval from the Messengers and there was differing among the nations, and there was an interruption from the ways and the teachings from the Wisdom, and obscurities from the banners of the Guidance and the proofs.
So he delivered the Message of his Lord, and implemented His Commands and fulfilled the Truth which he was upon, and he passed away and the Praiser is very much missed.

Then, these matters are in the Hands of Allah, all of them, causing them to flow to its reasons and its measurements. So Allah's Command flows by His Measurement, and Measured it to flow to its term, and flowing it to its prescribed time, and for every term there is a prescribed time. Allah Obliterates whatever He so Desires to and Establishes, and with Him is the Mother of the Book.

Thereafter, Allah Mighty and Majestic made the marital bond a cordiality for the hearts, and as a link linking it to the womb relationships, and Made it a kindness and a mercy, and in that are signs for the worlds.
And He it is Who Created a mortal from the water, so He made for him relationships of lineage and marriage.
And marry those among you who are single and those who are fit among your male slaves and your female slaves.

And, so and so, son of so and so is from the ones whom you know of his nobility and his lineage, and his doctrine in the etiquettes, and he has desired regarding participating with you and loves to be related to you, and has given you a proposal for your so and so young girl, daughter of so and so, and has extended to her such and such from the dower, the immediate being such and such, and the delayed being such and such.

Therefore accept our intercession and marry our proposer, and return him with a beautiful returning, and say beautiful words, and seek Forgiveness of Allah for me and for you all, and for the entirety of the Muslims.
ai.seo_question: What is the structure and content of the Imam's sermon on marriage in Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This sermon by Imam Al-Reza (AS) elegantly bridges theological cosmology with social jurisprudence, framing marriage not merely as a contract but as a manifestation of divine decree (Qadr) and mercy. It highlights the Shia emphasis on the Prophet’s role in restoring guidance after a period of spiritual neglect, while practically endorsing intermarriage among reputable families to strengthen communal bonds. The text serves as a comprehensive model for Islamic matrimonial proceedings, integrating spiritual gratitude with social responsibility.
